description: Combinational versus iterative DIV: the ALU's single-cycle divider against vcpu8_divider, a restoring divider that finds one quotient bit per clock (8 iterations). It measures what the 8 extra cycles per DIV cost against the area and the Fmax the iterative divider saves.

variants.name: div-comb
variants.description: Combinational divider inside the ALU: the default design (DIV_IMPL=COMB, DIV_ITER = 0).

variants.name: div-iter
variants.description: Iterative restoring divider, one quotient bit per clock; DIV waits 8 extra cycles in EXECUTE (DIV_IMPL=ITER).
